meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你生成可安全跳转的 2D/3D 关键帧动画，包括 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、Anime.js、WAAPI、FLIP、路径、遮罩、SVG 变形/描边、文字轨迹、3D 深度等，并会用 CLI 工具验证动画是否正确。
howto.when: 当你需要为 HyperFrames 合成添加关键帧动画，或诊断关键帧问题时触发。不要用于场景策略、品牌设计、媒体素材、字幕或通用视频规划。

say.text: 帮我给这个盒子做一个从左到右移动的关键帧动画。
用 CSS 关键帧让这个圆形淡入并放大。
say.note: Claude 会创建有限时长、有限迭代的 CSS 关键帧。

say.text: 检查当前合成的关键帧是否有错误。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you generate seek-safe 2D/3D keyframe animations including GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, etc., and verify them using CLI tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add keyframe animations to a HyperFrames composition or diagnose keyframe issues. Do not use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

say_en.text: Create a keyframe animation moving this box from left to right.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a GSAP timeline and register it in window.__timelines.

say_en.text: Use CSS keyframes to fade in and scale up this circle.
say_en.note: Claude will create finite-duration, finite-iteration CSS keyframes.

say_en.text: Check the current composition's keyframes for errors.
say_en.note: Claude will run hyperframes lint and hyperframes check.
